correctness.rationale: Fresh reconstruction in PG(2,3) verified all nine base multisets for distances 4 through 12: each spans dimension three, meets the Griesmer length, has the stated distance from maximum line multiplicity, and has locality two. Adding the full 13-point projective-plane multiset raises distance by 9 and length by 13, so every distance at least four meets Griesmer. The explicit small witnesses give lengths five and six at distances two and three, and the elementary lower bounds give the complete profile: length five at distances one and two, six at three, then Griesmer for every distance at least four.
residual_risks: Only ternary dimension three and all-symbol locality at most two are covered.

Its ternary exact tables in the later section are for locality one, not ternary dimension three with locality two. The older Hao-Xia-Chen ternary work concerns Singleton-like optimal LRCs.
